objective: Restore trustworthy autonomous execution, authority-aware health, channel integration, and exact-SHA deployment without creating duplicate control planes.
bottleneck: Malformed runnable task contract plus stale authority/deployment state prevents trustworthy autonomous deployment.
success: Autonomous task lifecycle is proven end-to-end, authority/deploy status is explicit, owner channel is reconciled, and all gates pass for an exact approved SHA.

steps.title: Harden deterministic task execution contract
steps.prompt: Implement the P0-1 section of the companion repair plan. Prefer aion_core/tasks.py and tests; avoid protected worker.py. Make malformed explicit DET runnable tasks reject/quarantine before execution and avoid retry burn.
steps.success_criteria: Malformed DET tasks never become RUNNING; valid task behavior unchanged.

steps.title: Repair and prove autonomous end-to-end task
steps.success_criteria: TASK-AA93D718 is proven with evidence and no stale claim or new unresolved failure.

steps.title: Surface authority drift in health
steps.prompt: Implement P0-4 from the companion plan without editing protected authority verifier/baseline files. Runtime health and deploy authority must be distinct and tested.
steps.success_criteria: Health reports authority drift without falsely declaring runtime corruption.

steps.title: Prepare protected authority re-freeze evidence
steps.prompt: Collect the exact evidence package described in Phase 4. Do not edit protected files.
steps.success_criteria: Owner/Fable receives SHA, drift files, history, test/security evidence, and recommended freeze candidate.

steps.title: Refresh generated state surfaces
steps.prompt: Implement Phase 5 from the companion plan: fix only non-protected generator logic if needed, regenerate surfaces through supported commands, and test capability wording.
steps.success_criteria: Generated setup/state docs match measured runtime capabilities.

steps.title: Reconcile OpenClaw loopback integration
steps.prompt: Implement Phase 6. Reuse existing OpenClaw/LucyOS integration and canonical AION state; no new transport queue or daemon.
steps.success_criteria: Loopback OpenClaw health and owner control path are proven using existing integration.

steps.title: Run unattended reliability proof
steps.exec_command: python3 -m unittest tests.test_plan_worker tests.test_recovery_injection tests.test_task_reliability tests.test_backup_encryption -q
steps.success_criteria: Fault/recovery gates pass with no stale claims, false completion, or unresolved errors.
